# Pixel Elevator Panel

A pixel-art style elevator panel for floors 1 to 6, built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Press floor buttons to queue them; the car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor, shows the current floor and direction, and opens its doors on arrival.

## Features

- Floor buttons 1–6 with queued state (lit when active)
- Car moves one floor per second
- Current floor and direction display (▲ up, ▼ down, ● idle)
- Doors open on arrival and close after a short delay
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus, hover, and pressed states
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Cohesive 4-color palette with pixel-art aesthetic
- No external dependencies, network requests, or inline event handlers

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Controls

- Click or tap a floor button to queue that floor
- Use Tab to navigate buttons and Enter/Space to activate

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `style.css` – styling and pixel-art theme
- `script.js` – elevator logic and simulation

## Notes

- The `[hidden]` CSS rule is included for compatibility.
- All event handling uses `addEventListener`.
- Buttons have `aria-label` attributes for accessibility.
